notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, gaining control of target player's next turn.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mindslaver from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mindslaver from your graveyard by paying {6}.
Pass the turn.
End the controlled opponent turn.
Repeat.
